turns.question: Which kind of customer call left people happiest in September 2026, and in what share of those calls?
turns.answer: Product calls left the most customers happiest in September 2026, with 75% of them ending in a positive mood (a model-derived label; delivery, pricing and returns returned no figure). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
